seo_title: Rajasthan HC: Factory-Stocked Vehicles Still Owe MV Tax
title: Rajasthan High Court: Motor Vehicle Tax Applies to Finished Vehicles Held at the Factory, Even Without Proof of Road Use
case_name: Honda Motorcycle and Scooter India Pvt. Ltd. v. Union of India & Ors. (decided with connected writ petitions, including one by Hero MotoCorp)
citation: D.B. Civil Writ Petition No. 8258/2026, decided 06.11.2026 (2026 RJ JP 31407 DB)
card_summary: Honda Motorcycle and Scooter India and other manufacturers challenged motor vehicle tax on finished vehicles held at their factories, arguing the tax should attach only once used on a road. A Division Bench dismissed the petitions, holding that a manufacturer's possession of a vehicle at its factory attracts tax under Section 4(1)(d) of the Rajasthan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1951, with no need to prove road use.
card_tip: A manufacturer holding finished vehicle stock at a Rajasthan factory should budget for motor vehicle tax from when the stock is held in the ordinary course of business, rather than waiting for registration or road use.
verification_notes: The case name, writ petition number (8258/2026), the decision date of 6 November 2026, the bench (Justices Arun Monga and Ashutosh Kumar), the holding on Section 4(1)(d) of the Rajasthan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1951 and on Section 39 of the Motor Vehicles Act, and the fact that the petition was decided along with connected petitions including one by Hero MotoCorp are confirmed consistently between Verdictum (which hosts the order text) and LiveLaw Biz's report. This item serves the foreign-company/MNC-subsidiary audience named in the firm's current research priorities, since Honda Motorcycle and Scooter India is a subsidiary of a Japanese manufacturer.
